reviews.text: This App has made my life so much better! As a woman entering into perimenopause/menopause I found  myself experiencing a lot of joint pain. By doing a variety of exercises on the daily burn App my pain has decreased and my athleticism has been restored!

reviews.title: Love the Workouts
reviews.text:
Daily Burn is my favorite fitness app. The classes and trainers are amazing. I love that there are longer classes and different levels of difficulty, so there’s room to progress. I use the app daily.

I only gave 4 stars because the app can be glitchy. A class you find on your lap top may not show up on your phone, if you search for a particular style of class and look at a class then use the back button, all of your search parameters are lost and you have to start over.  These are small things but do affect having a seamless experience

reviews.title: I love it!

reviews.title: Best workout app out there
reviews.text: I love Daily Burn. It has every kind of workout for every level. However I wish they would get more Inferno type intense hard workouts that are newer.

reviews.title: Ok
reviews.text: Not enough new workouts, not enough strength workouts that actually challenge you, no sprint interval training workouts. The strength for women that was added this year is very good but there are only 4 workouts in this program though 2 of the workouts are HIIT.

reviews.title: The new app is so much better than what came before it
reviews.text: The ability to search on multiple topics at once, for example  - time, style, intensity, and so many more. It’s also very handy to be able to see all the options in one particular program at once. I can’t say enough about how improved this is.

reviews.title: DB has great workouts!
reviews.text: I have been a DB member since 2009, and these workouts (especially DB365) have kept me going. A serious of injuries have interferred these last few years, but at 72 years old, I am able to get back to regular workouts and regain my strength. The diverse and challenging workouts give me a well rounded session without having to overthink things. So thankful for Daily Burn!

reviews.title: Great at-home classes
reviews.text: I use the app and service 5 days a week. My favorite feature is the DailyBurn365 that programs daily classes with different trainers. While this program is Jo longer live or new, they did it for 7 years which offers a ton of variety of styles and trainers. There are other series that are great, but the 365 is my jam for the novelty of new each day.

reviews.title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Fantastic App That Keeps Me Motivated!
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the Daily Burn workout app for a while now, and it has truly become one of the best parts of my daily routine. The variety of workouts is amazing—there’s something for every mood and fitness level, whether I want a quick 10-minute boost or a full, challenging session. The trainers are incredibly motivating without being overwhelming, and I love how each program feels thoughtfully designed.

The interface is clean and easy to navigate, and the ability to track my progress keeps me consistent. I also appreciate the welcoming, supportive vibe of the app—it makes working out feel fun instead of like a chore.

Overall, Daily Burn has helped me stay active, positive, and committed to my goals. Highly recommend to anyone looking for an easy, enjoyable way to get moving! 💪🔥

reviews.title: Can we make it better?
reviews.text: I have been using DailyBurn for 13 years. I am begging y’all to let me create folders of my favorites so they’re easier for me to find. Improve the search function so that I can actually find what I’m looking for. And please please please please fix the functionality with chromecast and airplay. It never works the first, second, or third time that I try to connect and then usually it’ll start playing on my phone halfway through the workout- and if I dare to pick up my phone??? The whole workout starts over. I have new devices. I have updated the app. This isn’t a me problem.

reviews.title: (At times) great workouts, mediocre app
reviews.text:
I was redeeming a free trial offer and I kept getting errors. The app itself isn’t the cleanest and feels like it’s missing functions to make it easier to find what you’re looking for. Yes, it’s nice to sort by the type of workout but you can only sort by one filter at a time, and the Titles of each work out are often vague and not very helpful when you just want a quick look at the list from your search results. 

     The workouts themselves can be very enjoyable and some of the trainers I’ve grown to like a lot, trainer Booker for example who ive stuck with. but often times other videos aren’t the easiest to do or follow for someone who is still a beginner. I often see a workout I’m interested in but then notice the many different types of workout equipment you may need just for the one workout so that ends up filtering me out from it. 

during many workouts the trainers would throw a real curveball at you and ask to do a very unconventional movement one is not used to and it really throws me off. I like consistency in a workout. Overall i like the energy from all the trainers though.

reviews.title: Impossible to cancel subscription
reviews.text: Once downloaded the app makes it impossible to cancel your subscription. I have been following all the directions to for at least an hour to no avail.

reviews.title: Best workout app
reviews.text: I have been using this app for about five years now, I’m in the best shape of my life. I’m 47 years old and I feel stronger than ever. This app suggests a daily workout that keeps every muscle in your body strong. You will work on different body parts, different workout types and you can always modify if you’re tired or need to for some other reason. I highly suggest you try this out.

reviews.title: Minimal Variety for the $
reviews.text: They claim there are thousands of workouts but it is really programs that use a few new workouts & re-use workouts from other programs. If you like Pilates or HIIT this may be the app but there is almost no strength workouts.

reviews.title: Stopped working and no support
reviews.text: I used this app for a year and I really liked it. However, the app stopped working a week ago-ish. Checked for updates, updated iOS, same result. Just freezes on the opening screen with the logo. Same thing on the iPhone and iPad. Went to the website to look for support chat or email or phone. Nothing. The only way to contact is to complete a form. After 3 days I received a preformatted response stating how to contact them and how to explain the issue. But I already did explain, they just didn’t read it. Terrible customer care. Too bad as I just paid for another year and now I have to get sone back.

reviews.title: Good work outs, faulty app
reviews.text: The workouts are good, but the app freezes or loses my place and progress sometimes. Quite frustrating

reviews.title: Nothing but issues so far
reviews.text: Took multiple attempts to actually create an account; finally did on my phone, then downloaded on my iPad and logged in, tried to do a workout but told me I needed to subscribe - even though I currently have a subscription. So I watched on my phone, first workout I tried was a yoga workout - 40 min video for 30 min workout - literally the first 10 minutes was a video of the cameramen/ set and things getting set up? Tried another video and there was another several-min ad at the beginning?

reviews.title: So far, So good
reviews.text:
I never use workout apps. I usually think that they want extra in app purchases and stuff like that. I got the three month free subscription with T-Mobile Tuesdays this week, and I’ve did four workouts so far with it. I combine it with the gym. I think I like this app because of the barre classes. I don’t have to go to the fancy studio to receive them. I really wanted to get into that specific exercise this year.
This makes me want to work out, and it makes me look forward to it. Also, because, whenever I login on my laptop, I can cast it to my TV. I don’t have to prop my phone up on some surface just to get it to work.

reviews.title: Easy to use EVERYWHERE
reviews.text: The diversity of workouts is so convenient to use ANYWHERE, particularly since most don’t involve any equipment. The few that do one only needs maybe a band and set of dumbbells. This is my go to on short drive weekend trips or big travel to do from my hotel room/cabin/villa. Companies really should invest in their employees with a corporate account to provide this service to staff. Especially if they require them to travel. This is an invaluable, streamlined fitness app unlike others that are busy with music and talking instructors. This app, one can exercise to near dead silence, choose from their Spotify playlists, or play your own tunes. The mood is yours to set.

reviews.title: Love the variety
reviews.text: I love the variety. I can pick the daily workout or a workout from the library. Some days I want less intense, others more intense and Daily Burn has them all! All the instructors have great attitudes and speak words of encouragement with great demonstrations.

reviews.title: Can’t connect Apple Watch or Fitness Tracker
reviews.text: The video presentation looks great, with calories burned, audio, and also can connect to a fitness tracker. However after you install it that is not an option!! What happened?as a new use I’m disappointed. Bring back the old UI!
